The issuer exhibits a solid balance sheet with strong solvency (equity of $4.07B against $7.50B in liabilities), good liquidity (current ratio of 1.35x), and healthy profitability (EBIT margin of ~23.2% and ROA of ~4.9%). However, the overall size of revenues ($2.46B) and absolute earnings profile place it firmly in the investment-grade spectrum without reaching the top-tier mega-cap profile required for an A or AA rating.

DECISION: BBB+
